question: Does the original four-bit Qwen3.5-9B sparse native-memory write and normalization-aware reader transfer unchanged from arbitrary letter dictionaries to the published CAPITALS binding task? The prompted country must be bound to a person, then the model must supply the capital. The paper is Feng and Steinhardt, ICLR 2024. This is an adapted causal evaluation of an independently designed synthetic benchmark.
source: jiahai-feng/binding-iclr@fb7608dd4c255ac37d7e95c5c8bf45b5512901eb, authors' name and country/capital CSVs, both original DEFAULT and WORK completion templates from coref/datasets/capitals.py. Reimplement their NumPy prompt-id permutations and one-word-token criterion for this checkpoint. Use the first three names and countries, with distinct capital answer IDs. All prompt IDs fixed and all cases scored. No chat wrapper: reserve the last four tokens of the authors' exact completion prefix as the read suffix. The correct token is the leading-space capital. No model responses used in selection.
roles: Set query index to seed modulo three to cover all three positions. Target donor exchanges the query subject's country with the next cyclic subject's; nuisance donor exchanges the other two countries. For both templates and donors score native recipient and full donor, same 256-coordinate write under native, state-Gram whitened or 16-step normalized reading, and all last-slot value channels at this layer under native reading as a higher-budget diagnostic. Compare written and unwritten branches of both query-changing methods. Free top token from whole vocabulary, true donor-minus-recipient margin, no constrained candidates. Score all, and separately cases on which both clean branches are correct. Record top outcomes against both original and alternate capitals, nuisance stability versus the original native answer and literal correctness.
dev: Use 12 fixed prompt IDs 51973000..51973011 in both formats with both roles. Keep original 28th (zero-based) layer, heads 28/29, donor boundary, write budget, optimizer and caps. Independent template adaptation only; no model fitting or site selection. Timings with shared prefixes cannot support speed claims.
promotion: Run confirmation only if both clean prompts give the intended answers on at least 18/24 target prompts, normalized written targets beat each same-write baseline (whitening and native) by at least 4/24, all correctly answered native nuisance and unwritten prompts stay correct, and no native incorrect nuisance or unwritten answer changes to a different incorrect answer. Publish all denominators and source pins even when the original site fails to generalize.
confirmation: If development passes, use 64 fresh prompt IDs 51974000..51974063, both templates; require a positive paired 95% seed-bootstrap gain against both same-write comparators, at least 10 additional successes, and preservation of every native-correct control. Otherwise stop with no held-out prompt inference.
cost: Local pinned 9B; up to 8 minutes for pilot, 40 minutes for conditional confirmation, one engineering repair. No paid credits. Native opportunity and higher-budget controls must be reported.
